title: Return catalog labels without copying
description: A catalog lookup refactor changes its label return type and membership test.
commitMessage: Use string_view for display labels and simplify membership lookup.
reviewContext: C++17. add inserts a previously absent ID and returns true, without overwriting an existing ID. Supplied names are nonempty. contains must answer membership without changing the catalog. label must return an independently owned prefixed string that remains usable after the call and after catalog changes. Unknown labels raise out_of_range. Calls are single-threaded in this exercise.
